message: 最強の魔王

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Paqy.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What is it, Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「Since I'm the Demon Lord and all, isn't there some kind of cheat where I awaken to a mysterious power and suddenly get strong?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's not like there isn't one.」

name: Synn
message: 「Right... that kind of thing is the privilege of the hero who defeats the Demon Lord, isn't it...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't just jump to your own conclusions. I'm telling you there is one.」

name: Synn
message: 「Really!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Trust the words of the Great Sage. Though, I forgot how to do it.」

name: Synn
message: 「What a useless familiar...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Still, didn't you dislike that sort of thing, Demon Lord? If you suddenly got the urge to conquer the world or the Demon World, you'd better drop it. Not that I'll stop you.」

name: Synn
message: 「...I just don't want to make anyone worry.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Aze-boy?」
My heart skipped a beat.
Indeed, the very first face that came to my mind was Azel's.

name: Synn
message: 「...Everyone.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sure, if you got strong all at once, those Demons from before would be a piece of cake.」

name: Synn
message: 「I thought if I had amazing power that could guarantee victory, I wouldn't have to worry anyone.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Listen here, Demon Lord. No matter how much power you gain, the worries never go away.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Because there's no end to power.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even if you're the strongest right now, there's always a chance someone stronger is out there, and there's no guarantee someone stronger won't show up in the future.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Plus, you might get weaker as you grow old.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, that might be true, but.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Being the 'strongest' is just a relative term, after all. That's why you end up worrying about when someone might surpass you. Having power itself becomes a source of worry.」

name: Synn
message: 「If you're overwhelmingly strong, you might not have any of those worries, you know?」

name: Paqy
message: 「There's no such thing as absolute. If you don't keep that in mind, you'll fall into the trap of arrogance next. And then you'll get tripped up by some worthless small fry.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Seeking power isn't necessarily a bad thing. But if you don't know its limits, it won't end well.」

name: Synn
message: 「You sound kinda cool, Paqy. Like a Great Sage.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Not 'like.' I am a Great Sage. Though, this is just secondhand wisdom.」

name: Synn
message: 「How humble.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, yeah. They're the words of the First Demon Lord, after all. If you ask me, he was the strongest Demon Lord there's ever been.」

name: Synn
message: 「What kind of person was he?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Anyway, he was the absolute strongest.」

name: Synn
message: 「I get that he was the strongest, so what kind of person was he?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hmph... I forgot all about stuff from that long ago.」

name: Synn
message: 「Saying it cool doesn't get you off the hook.」
